helpDraw: d                        turn one card from the stock (no redeal)
helpMoveRF: m r f                    the terrace top to a foundation (its only destination)
helpMoveWF: m w f                    the waste top to a foundation
helpMoveWT: m w t <pile>             the waste top to a tableau pile
helpMoveTF: m t <pile> f             a tableau top to a foundation
helpMoveTT: m t <from> t <to>        one card between tableau piles
promptReserveTo: The terrace can only reach a foundation (enter f):
invalidFromZone: Invalid source: {{val}} (use r, w or t)
reserveOnlyToFoundation: A terrace card can only go to a foundation: {{val}} (use f)
awaitingBase: The base rank is not set yet. The first card you send to a foundation fixes it
undoToEscape: Undo {{count}} move(s) to escape the dead end (undo {{count}}, or repeat u)
helpExampleAuto: ac                       send everything that can go to a foundation
invalidUndoCount: Invalid undo count: {{val}} (give a whole number of 1 or more)
helpUndoN: undo <n>                 undo n moves at once (to escape a dead end)
